title: National Biodiversity Authority Disburses ₹3.79 Crore Under ABS

blocks.content: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) disbursed nearly ₹3.79 crore on 9 August 2026 under the Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) mechanism. The amount was distributed to 33 State Biodiversity Boards, Union Territory Biodiversity Councils, the ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources, and the Hisar Bovine Sperm Station and Research Centre.

items: The National Biodiversity Authority was established under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.
People’s Biodiversity Registers record local biological resources and associated traditional knowledge at the local level.
Biodiversity Heritage Sites are areas notified for unique, ecologically fragile, or culturally important biodiversity.
The NBA’s cumulative ABS disbursements crossed ₹166 crore after the latest transfer.
